start: Members page; the gym's records are online and some members joined in the MettleUp app

steps.action: Tap the tab 'Joined in the app'
user_sees: Under the title: 'Who has the MettleUp app on their phone'
No '+ Add member' or 'Import from Excel' buttons on this tab
Line 'Members who joined your gym in the MettleUp app with gym code <code>.'
One card per app member: name, 'Joined <how long ago> · last seen <how long ago>', and on the right '<n> orders' or 'No orders yet' over '<amount> paid for shop orders' or 'No shop orders paid yet'
must_not: A member of another gym
Membership fees counted in 'paid for shop orders'
An endless 'Loading…'

steps.action: Tap a member who is already in the member list (same mobile number)
user_sees: That member's own page
must_not: The add form for someone already in the list
Another member with a similar number

start: 'Joined in the app' tab; one app member is not in the gym's member list yet (the other kind of row)

user_sees: 'Not in your member list yet. Tap to add them.' under their name
must_not: The line on a member who is in the list under the same number

user_sees: The add-member form opens with the name and the mobile number already filled in
must_not: An empty form to retype
A mobile number with a wrong or doubled country code

user_sees: The new member's page; back on the tab the line 'Not in your member list yet' is gone for them
must_not: Two members for one person

start: The gym is online but nobody has joined in the app; or the gym's records are not online yet

steps.action: Open the tab with nobody joined
user_sees: 'Nobody has joined in the app yet'
'Ask members to open the MettleUp app and join with gym code <code>. They show up here at once.'
must_not: A blank list
A wrong or empty gym code

steps.action: Open the tab on a gym whose records are not online
user_sees: A card about the gym code and going online (exact words not read)
must_not: An error
A list from an earlier sign-in

steps.action: Open the tab when the server cannot be reached
user_sees: A red message in plain words; the earlier list stays if there was one
must_not: 'Nobody has joined in the app yet' shown for a failed read

start: The tab is open on the owner's screen

steps.action: A member joins with the gym code on their phone
user_sees: Their card appears within about a minute without a reload
must_not: The card needing a sign-out to appear
The page jumping while it refreshes

steps.action: That member leaves the gym in their app
user_sees: Their card goes at the next refresh
must_not: A left member still listed with 'last seen'

user_sees: The list is read again
must_not: An old list from the first visit

user_sees: Name, when they joined, when their app was last seen, how many shop orders and what they paid for them
must_not: What the member trained, their body weight or photos
Members who use the app but joined another gym

start: Front desk signed in; a member says they have installed the app

user_sees: The same list as the owner sees, with the gym code line
must_not: Gym money totals
An error because the desk is not the owner

steps.action: Find the member and tap their card
user_sees: Their own page when they are in the list; else the add form with name and number filled in
must_not: A second member made for someone already in the list

start: Front desk; nobody has joined yet

user_sees: 'Nobody has joined in the app yet' with the gym code to tell members
must_not: A blank page
'Loading…' that never ends

start: Front desk; a member joined in the app but typed a different mobile number than the one in the list

steps.action: Open the tab and find them
user_sees: 'Not in your member list yet. Tap to add them.' although the person is a member
must_not: The two silently joined under the wrong person

steps.action: Fix the member's number on their page and come back
user_sees: The line is gone; a tap now opens their page
must_not: The line staying until the next sign-in

start: Front desk on a shared computer

user_sees: Names, join time, last-seen time and shop spend of app members
must_not: Workout data of a member
The amount a member paid for shop orders summed into a gym total
